status: Native CUDA source-correct F16 latent QKV front qualified; full attention/KV/cache/forward admission and whole goal remain open

implementation.pipeline: Batched immutable F16 q_a GEMM, source vector4 rank RMSNorm, batched q_b and wkv GEMMs, source strided trailing-query GPT-J rotation without Q-head normalization, and source fused pair-RMSNorm plus rotation for KV.
implementation.rounding: KV uses the original pair summation, warp-down reduction and dtype-specific weight rounding. It is not replaced with standalone vector4 RMSNorm. BF16 weight multiplication precedes F16 conversion; F16 weights multiply the separately rounded normalized half values.
implementation.resources: Uses existing linear_f16_reserve 48MiB private workspace/handles. Five disjoint request-owned activation views plus explicit frequency/optional position metadata. No implicit table generation, KV append, allocation, transfer, synchronization or weight upload during execution.
implementation.validation: Preflights all three linear operations, rank norm and both rotations before checking topology and queuing any work. Malformed late KV plans preserve all outputs. Scalar dimensions are validated before subtraction/multiplication. Borrowed immutable weights belong to this backend; activation and metadata views belong to this request.
implementation.ownership: No model/session/provider changes, model-family predicates, mutable globals or GPU handles on CPU model weights. Private GPU translation unit and validation subfile within existing CUDA backend. Existing norm arithmetic unchanged; only its preflight was extracted for composition.

profile.frequency_family: Plain main frequencies for sliding layers0/1; compressed YaRN family for layers2..39, selected from exact V4.1 source/config.
profile.frequency_scope: Tables generated only in independent reference capture by unchanged pinned util/rope.py with torch2.14.0+cu130. Production operation accepts explicit immutable frequency views; production derivation is not claimed.
profile.positions: All40 layers at rows1/7, positions0/1/65535/context-7. Layers0/2/20/39 additionally rows31/32/33/64/129/256 and non-monotonic explicit positions. Synthetic tests include large INT32 positions and strided norm padding/idle heads.

source.rope_kernel: Unchanged rope.cu kernel body with unchanged extracted sincos_accurate and warp_reduce_sum_f helpers; source GPT-J launch geometry retained.
source.independent_weights: 120 actual q_a/q_b/wkv matrices from preserved original FP8-to-F16 captures, and BF16 q/kv norm parameters from original storage-policy captures. Candidate probe obtains handles from existing production core/parameter owner.
source.source_captures: Original and paired system-cuBLAS captures are both retained; two repeated executions per source case are stable. Integrated native QKV compares against paired precision/library behavior; pure RoPE additionally compares original-library raw-projection inputs and outputs.

correctness.comparison: Every compared QA, normalized low-rank Q, rotated Q/KV, input, frequency and explicit-position tensor is byte-exact. Two independently owned requests persist across all cases in forward/reverse order; all allocation halos remain unchanged; execution resident_alloc count stays zero.
correctness.synthetic: Eleven source standalone RoPE fixtures x2requests x2repeats =44 executions. Six source composed QKV fixtures x2requests x2repeats =24 executions. Covers late malformed plans, foreign requests, metadata overlap, full/slim/strided heads, dtype rounding, readonly metadata, output guards and retry without mutation.

trace.scope: One warmed layer39 R256 pos31 compressed-family QKV front; core/parameter setup, input/frequency writes and source comparisons outside capture

trace.limitation: Projection, normalization and rotation only. Frequency tables supplied explicitly; no KV append/compression/selection/attention/output projection, full-model latency or vLLM parity claim.

limitations: Projection/norm/rotation front only. Production frequency construction, request-owned window/compressed KV state, compression/index/candidate selection, attention, grouped output projection, Engram and complete forward/generation/CLI admission still require integration.
This F16 RoPE operation must not be substituted for an F32 attention-output de-rotation epilogue; rounding boundaries differ.
Device qualification is on the selected 188-SM sm_120a GPU only. Declared generic shape bounds are not an all-shape/all-device validation claim.

Runtime validation code inside CUDA translation units is not claimed to be host-ASAN instrumented; ASAN/UBSAN covers probe and selected model/reader/layout code, and CUDA memory/init/race tools cover device execution.
Warm trace is a single QKV front call, not a full-model or vLLM parity benchmark.
